설탕.x: Do you put sugar in your coffee?

수영.x: In summer I swim in the sea.

을-를.forms: 을 after a consonant (밥을) · 를 after a vowel (커피를)
을-를.x: I drink coffee in the morning.
을-를.e: 을 after a consonant (밥을), 를 after a vowel (커피를).
을-를.t: In casual speech it's often dropped or shortened: 뭘 (뭐를), 날 (나를).

화장.ex: 오늘은 시간이 없어서 화장을 안 했어요.
화장.x: I didn't put on makeup today because I had no time.
화장.t: 화장실 'restroom' literally means 'makeup room', a handy memory link.

여행지.ex: 제주도는 한국 사람들에게 인기 있는 여행지예요.
여행지.x: Jeju Island is a popular travel destination for Koreans.

바닥.ex: 한국에서는 바닥에 앉아서 밥을 먹기도 해요.
바닥.x: In Korea, people sometimes sit on the floor to eat.
바닥.e: Also the bottom of anything: 신발 바닥 'sole of a shoe', 손바닥 'palm'.

가입하다.m: to join, to sign up, to register
가입하다.ex: 이 사이트에 가입하면 할인 쿠폰을 줘요.
가입하다.x: If you sign up for this site, they give you a discount coupon.
가입하다.t: Pronounced [가이파다]; use N에 가입하다: 사이트에, 동아리에, 보험에 가입하다.

아무것.x: I've been so busy that I haven't eaten anything since morning.
아무것.t: 아무거나 ('anything is fine') is very common when ordering food or choosing.

위층.ex: 위층에서 밤마다 쿵쿵 뛰는 소리가 나요.
위층.x: Every night there's a thumping sound of someone running upstairs.
위층.e: Native 위 'above' + 층 'floor, story'. Opposite: 아래층 'downstairs'.
위층.t: Spelled 위층, never 윗층: no ㅅ is added before an aspirated sound like ㅊ. Noise from the flat above (층간 소음 'between-floor noise') is a classic cause of neighbor disputes in Korean apartments.

야생.forms: 야생이 · 야생을 (often before a noun: 야생 동물)
야생.ex: 이 공원에서는 야생 동물을 가까이에서 볼 수 있어요.
야생.x: In this park, you can see wild animals up close.
야생.e: Literally 'living in the fields': growing up in nature.

야식.ex: 밤에 배가 고파서 야식으로 치킨을 시켰어요.
야식.x: I got hungry at night, so I ordered fried chicken as a late-night snack.
야식.e: Literally 'night food' — a big part of Korean delivery culture.

호떡.x: In winter, I crave the hotteok sold on the street.
호떡.e: 호 'foreign (Chinese)' + 떡 'rice cake' — introduced by Chinese merchants.
호떡.t: Filled with brown sugar, cinnamon and nuts. Bite carefully: the melted syrup is very hot.

드라이클리닝.ex: 이 코트는 세탁소에 드라이클리닝을 맡겨야 해요.
드라이클리닝.x: I need to take this coat to the cleaner's for dry cleaning.
드라이클리닝.t: At the 세탁소, just say 드라이클리닝 해 주세요. Ordinary washing in water is 물세탁.

연극배우.ex: 그는 연극배우로 시작해서 지금은 영화에도 나와요.
연극배우.x: He started as a stage actor and now appears in movies too.

감격.ex: 우승이 확정되자 선수들은 감격의 눈물을 흘렸어요.
감격.x: When the championship was confirmed, the players shed tears of emotion.
감격.t: 감격 is stronger and more overwhelming than 감동; often in 감격의 눈물 (tears of joy).

충동적.ex: 세일이라서 충동적으로 비싼 옷을 사 버렸어요.
충동적.x: It was on sale, so I impulsively bought expensive clothes.
충동적.t: 충동구매 'impulse buying' is a very common collocation.

한창.m: in full swing, at the peak, in the middle of
한창.ex: 지금 한창 회의 중이니까 나중에 전화해 주세요.
한창.x: We're right in the middle of a meeting, so please call back later.
한창.t: Don't confuse 한창 'at the peak' with 한참 'for a long time'.

전화위복.ex: 그때 회사를 그만둔 것이 오히려 전화위복이 됐어요.
전화위복.x: Quitting the company back then actually turned out to be a blessing in disguise.

제약.ex: 시간의 제약 때문에 모든 곳을 볼 수 없었어요.
제약.x: Because of time constraints, I couldn't see every place.
제약.t: Homonym warning: 제약 also means 'drug manufacturing', as in 제약 회사 'pharmaceutical company'.

핫플.ex: 요즘 이 동네가 핫플이라서 주말엔 사람이 많아요.
핫플.x: This neighborhood is a hot spot these days, so it's crowded on weekends.
핫플.e: Clipped from 핫플레이스, from English 'hot place'; English speakers would say 'hot spot'.
핫플.t: Casual. People visit 핫플 to try the food and take 인증샷 for social media.

탄핵.x: The National Assembly passed the motion to impeach the president.
탄핵.t: In Korea the Assembly votes to impeach, then the Constitutional Court decides on removal (파면).

실형.x: He was sentenced to two years in prison with no suspension.
실형.t: News contrasts 실형 with 집행유예 (a suspended sentence).

청천벽력.m: a bolt from the blue, shocking news
청천벽력.ex: 그 소식은 우리 가족에게 청천벽력 같았어요.
청천벽력.x: That news hit our family like a bolt from the blue.
청천벽력.e: Literally 'a thunderbolt from a clear blue sky'.

기고만장.m: being puffed up with pride; cockiness, arrogance
기고만장.ex: 그는 한 번 이기더니 기고만장해서 아무 말도 안 들어요.
기고만장.x: After winning once, he got so cocky that he won't listen to anyone.
기고만장.t: Usually 기고만장하다 or 기고만장해지다, said critically about someone else.

딴청을 피우다.forms: 딴청을 피워요 · 딴청을 피웠어요 · 딴청 피우지 마
딴청을 피우다.m: to act as if one didn't hear; to pretend to be busy with something else
딴청을 피우다.ex: 숙제 얘기를 하자 아이는 딴청을 피웠어요.
딴청을 피우다.x: When I brought up homework, the kid pretended not to hear.
딴청을 피우다.e: Built on 딴 'other, different' — acting busy with something else.
딴청을 피우다.t: 딴전을 피우다 means the same thing.

야망.ex: 그는 세계적인 기업을 만들겠다는 야망을 품고 있어요.
야망.x: He harbors the ambition of building a world-class company.
야망.e: Literally 'wild hope' — a big, bold desire.
야망.t: Collocation: 야망을 품다 (to harbor an ambition); 야망 can sound slightly ruthless, unlike 꿈.

서약.ex: 신입 사원들은 첫날 비밀 유지 서약을 했습니다.
서약.x: The new employees took a confidentiality pledge on their first day.
서약.e: Literally 'vowed promise' — more formal and official than 약속.

면책.ex: 국회의원은 국회에서 한 발언에 대해 면책 특권을 가집니다.
면책.x: Lawmakers have immunity for statements made in the National Assembly.

저당.m: mortgage, pledge of property as collateral
저당.ex: 그는 집을 저당 잡히고 은행에서 돈을 빌렸습니다.
저당.x: He mortgaged his house and borrowed money from the bank.
저당.t: The borrower says 집을 저당 잡히다 'to mortgage the house'; the bank 저당 잡다 'holds it as collateral'.

채권시장.x: The bond market became unstable as interest rates rose.
채권시장.t: 채권 'bond' sounds the same as 채권 'a creditor's claim'; context tells them apart.

자가면역.x: Rheumatoid arthritis is a typical autoimmune disease.
자가면역.e: Literally 'immunity against one's own house' — the body attacks itself.

균형미.ex: 이 탑은 좌우 대칭이 완벽해서 균형미가 뛰어나요.
균형미.x: This pagoda has perfect symmetry, so its balance is outstanding.

고전무용.ex: 동생은 어릴 때부터 고전무용을 배워 왔어요.
고전무용.x: My younger sister has been learning classical dance since she was little.

해악.ex: 흡연의 해악은 이미 잘 알려져 있어요.
해악.x: The harms of smoking are already well known.
